sources.title: kaivoss/AliceAI-T5-35B-A0.6B-chat-lora-v2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A LoRA adapter (rank 16, alpha 16) for yandex/AliceAI-T5-35B-A0.6B, a 35B-total / .6B-active sparse-MoE encoder-decoder base model with no chat format. It teaches the model to chat, to call tools when a task needs them, to answer in text when it does not, and to say nothing when there is nothing to say.

sources.title: AliceAI-T5-35B-A0.6B: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Overview AliceAI-T5-35B-A0.6B is a base encoder-decoder language model from yandex, implemented for Hugging Face Transformers. Its sparse mixture-of-experts architecture contains 34-35 billion unique parameters, with 512 experts in each MoE layer and top-8 routing per token.
